answer: What breaks first is the idle account. Reputation decays every epoch an identity does not work, so a parked farm loses its standing before it can be sold or reused. Link two identities and both reset to zero, which makes the usual funding pattern a self-inflicted wound. The check replays the submitted text, so a new slug does not hide a reused body. A harbor of dormant accounts is worth nothing after six epochs, and a haven that shares one wallet is already flagged. Copper now, nothing later.
